description: 1. GRAPH PARSING: Agent must open references/graph.jsonl, filter only lines where op=='put' (ignoring 'edge', 'del', 'meta' ops), and index entities by id. 2. DERIVATION CHAIN TRAVERSAL: Agent must use ONLY 'implies' and 'depends_on' relations (derivation_chain_valid: True per schema.yaml) to trace: axiom_001 → theorem_ict → theorem_symmetry_ethics and axiom_003 → theorem_ict. Agents using 'paired_with' or 'contrasts_with' as derivation steps will fail. 3. FIELD SELECTION (proprietary trap): For Aphorisms, must use the 'text' field verbatim. For Axioms/Theorems, must use the 'statement' field. For Concepts, must use the 'definition' field. Mixing these (e.g., using 'definition' for an aphorism) is wrong and detectable. 4. CITATION FORMAT: Must use the exact blockquote format: > "[exact text]" / > — *An Immanent Metaphysics*, [section], [URL] with the URL taken from the entity's 'location' field. 5. SYNTHESIS LABELING: The Basal Motivation → Right Action synthesis section must be explicitly labeled as agent synthesis (not presented as a direct quote). 6. SUMMARY TABLE: Must include a markdown table with entity name, type, and the location URL for all chain nodes. 7. ATTRIBUTION: Must attribute to Forrest Landry's An Immanent Metaphysics.
